title: Follow-up pair, recall side: retrieve the witness token from history
prompt:
Canonical corpus task (id t08, shape: fresh-thread follow-up, recall side). A previous corpus task (t07) in this same channel posted a final answer containing a witness token of the form {WITNESS_PREFIX}xxxx (x is a lowercase hex digit). This thread starts fresh with no inherited notes: retrieve that token from the channel's message history.
1. Call search_messages once with query '{WITNESS_PREFIX}' and limit 5.
2. Identify the exact witness token from t07's final answer (the t07 thread in this channel).
Rules: at most 2 search calls total; do not guess the token.
Expected final answer: a single line containing the exact witness token you retrieved. If you cannot retrieve it, report 'witness=not-found'.
note: Waste shape: fresh-thread follow-up (E4/M-3). Success = the exact seeded witness is recalled via search across threads; wrong or guessed tokens fail the equality check. {WITNESS_PREFIX} is filled per side and per run so older runs cannot pollute the recall.
